note: Fifteen drive-in sites on and around Sawmill Point on Cooke Dam Pond, off River Road west of Oscoda; most (045D-057D) ring the point above the pond, while 042D-044D sit among private cabins to the south. Twelve take a 23-ft rig; 042D, 044D and 051D are 18 ft. Part of the AuSable River Dispersed Camping system: 102 designated sites along 55 miles of the lower AuSable in the Huron NF, booked as one recreation.gov facility. Dirt or gravel parking aprons; the sites sit on bluffs 5-300 ft above the river and access to the water can be steep. Equipment within 25 ft of the site post; two vehicles and two camping units per site. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov + per-site catalog + FS page: FS-run (Huron Shores RD), $10 Apr 15 - Nov 30 (confirmed), free and no permit Dec 1 - Apr 14, 50% Senior/Access on one site (stated). Fifteen drive-in sites at the pin (loop 'Sawmill Point'), twelve a 23-ft motorhome fits (to 26-30 ft, 048D pull-through), three 18 ft. Added max_rig_ft 30, pull-through, no water/sewer, 14-night limit, URL; season derived opens 04-15 -> year-round (not maintained Dec 1 - Apr 14). Current Huron-Manistee alerts (April 2026 flooding, March 2026 winter storm, Iargo Springs closure) name no AuSable River campsite or road near it; the standing 'Au Sable National Scenic River Camping Restrictions' order only confines camping to designated sites.
